dedupe_keys.name: sri lanka nsdi transport layers rda national road and expressway network railway lines airports and road classes

description: The Sri Lanka National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI) publishes transport map services on its public ArcGIS Server. Contents: the Transport service has 17 layers, among them 2,040 railway line features, 8 airports, helicopter pads and runways, 174 expressway segments, 3,399 class A main road and 7,394 class B main road segments, 27,273 secondary and minor road segments, jeep tracks, footpaths, road rights of way and interchanges; the separate RDA service from the Road Development Authority carries the national road network (845 features), the expressway network and interchanges. Producer: the Survey Department's NSDI unit, with the RDA layers from the Road Development Authority. Coverage: the whole island. Format and access: ArcGIS MapServer services with query capability, so features can be exported as JSON or GeoJSON through the REST query endpoint; the NSDI geoportal shows them on a map and metadata is in the NSDI catalogue. Licence: no licence is stated on the services. Caveats: the road classes follow the Survey Department topographic data, not a routable network, so connectivity needs checking; update dates are not shown in the service description. Simulation uses: road and rail network models for accessibility and evacuation, exposure of national roads to floods and landslides, and freight corridor studies. Related records: the NSDI utilities and communications layers (data-sri-lanka-nsdi-utilities-communications-electricity-water-sewer-layers) come from the same server.
